boundary: This audit compares observable capability coverage only. It is not a post-hoc weighted quality score and does not establish superiority over a human coach.

checks.description: Preserve every narrow comparison that the deterministic evidence marks as supported.
Explicitly refuse a club athletic-performance trend.
Treat the Atlas water observation as wind-confounded context rather than crew causation.
Prioritize the missing 4x plan, women's 8x context, and Andre record reconciliation.
Request human or source context for every unresolved route without inventing an answer.
Route both verification-passed session deviations to coach review without inferring their cause.
Use only supplied evidence references, keep priorities human-reviewed, and preserve water/indoor and causal boundaries.
